title: compliance bonsai notes - lightweight SOC2 prep
content:
Purpose:
- Quick, portable brain-dump for mapping SOC2-ish controls to tiny evidence paths. Lightweight: usable by an engineer to find or produce artifacts quickly.

Scope note:
- Focus on hosted + dedicated + private (VPC) surfaces. Ignore org-level HR/People controls (we reference HR runbook link instead).

High-level control buckets (first-pass):
1) Identity & access: SSO, SCIM provisioning, least-privilege roles for Console/API/Private CP
2) Key management: KMS/HSM usage for model keys, customer-supplied keys, rotation cadence
3) Network isolation: VPC peering, private endpoints, egress controls for private deployments
4) Change control & CI/CD: PR review, gated deploys, canary rollouts, deploy approval logs
5) Logging & monitoring: token-level traces redacted, audit logs retention, alerting hooks
6) Incident response & forensics: runbooks, pager rotations, tabletop notes
7) Data isolation for Dedicated: dataset tagging, ephemeral cache purge, tenant separation tests
8) Model governance/evals: model onboarding checklist, regression gates, evaluation artifacts

Quick mapping ideas (control -> likely evidence path + owner):
- SSO account provisioning: evidence = SCIM logs (okta) + invite audit CSV (admin console). Owner: Product Security / IT. Jira: TRUST-412.
- KMS usage for customer keys: evidence = CloudKMS audit logs (encrypt/decrypt API calls) + KMS policy snapshot (terraform state). Owner: Infra-crypto.
- Private deployment network posture: evidence = VPC subnet ACLs (terraform), bastion jump logs, egress fw rules. Owner: Private Deployments PM.
- Deployment approval trail: evidence = GitHub protected-branch settings, approval comments on PRs, CI run artifacts. Owner: Release Eng.
- Audit log retention: evidence = Loki/ELK index configuration (retention days) + sample query results showing events older than X. Owner: Observability.

Open questions / follow-ups (needed to close controls):
- Q1: Do Dedicated instances write any customer tokens to shared S3 logs? (ASK: infra-team)
- Q2: Where is the canonical list of service accounts for cross-account access? Some repos use different names. Need one canonical CSV. (Owner: Platform Eng)
- Q3: For Private on-prem package, what is the documented hardening checklist we ship? Possible gap: SSH user management. (Owner: Private Deployments)
- Q4: Is KV cache purge automated on instance teardown? Need a reproducible test or script.

Mini-runbook for evidence collection (for engineer doing rapid evidence pack):
1) Identify control ID and owner from TRUST board.
2) Ask owner for: terraform state snapshots, cloud audit log query, PR urls, sample redacted logs.
3) Produce 1-page artifact: what we checked, sample outputs, commands run (timestamped), link to config files.
4) Add evidence to Confluence page and attach hashed zip to JIRA.

Sample control sketch (rough text to drop into Confluence):
- Control name: API key issuance and rotation
- Control intent: Ensure issuance and rotation of API keys follows least-privilege and is logged
- Activities: central key-store, automated rotation every 90 days, single-use keys for temporary jobs, PR approval for long-lived keys
- Evidence to exhibit: key issuance audit (CSV), rotation cron logs, code snippet of rotation lambda, approval PRs

Cheat-sheet queries / commands (starter examples)
- GCP audit logs (quick): gcloud logging read "resource.type=gae_app AND protoPayload.methodName=\"google.iam.credentials.v1.GenerateAccessToken\"" --limit 50 --freshness 30d
- Terraform state: grep -n "kms_key" terraform.tfstate | head -n 20
- GitHub: search "protect-branch" in org settings + list org-admins

Evidence hygiene notes:
- Redact PII and customer data — keep only ids and boolean evidence when possible.
- Timestamp everything and include the query used to extract samples.
- Prefer snapshots (terraform diff, policy files) rather than ephemeral outputs when available.

Fast wins (low-effort, high-impact):
- Add a short README to each infra repo with the single-line path to the most relevant audit logs for SOC2 reviewers.
- Script to snapshot KMS IAM policy + rotate-proof logs into a dated folder (cron weekly).
- One-off tabletop to validate incident runbook for Private deployments (30–60 min).

Notes to self (todo list):
- [ ] Chat with Omar (infra) about cache purge behaviour (blocker for Dedicated data isolation).
- [ ] Create Confluence stub page: "Control mappings - lightweight" and populate first 6 controls.
- [ ] Hook up TRUST board link to sample evidence artifacts.
- [ ] Draft the API key control text and ping Release Eng for evidence.

Random scribbles / heuristics:
- If a control references "access logs" expect a 3-step hunt: storage location -> retention policy -> sample export.
- Don’t rely on dashboard screenshots alone: reviewers often ask for raw log lines and query used.

Slack snippets to search for (keywords):"kms rotate", "cache purge", "vpc egress", "private deploy ssh", "audit retention"

OK — Good starting point. Keep this lean and iterative. Will convert the top mappings into a Confluence page and assign owners.

-- Rae
